newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian GDP rose 2.8 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Latvian GDP rose 2.8 pct in 1996.

text.p: Latvian gross domestic product (GDP) in comparative prices rose by 2.8 percent in 1996, the statistics committee said on Thursday.
It said in a statement that the figures were preliminary and may change after companies report on their 1996 activities, due to be done by the end of April.
The committee said that GDP in real prices rose to 2.77 billion lats in 1996 compared with 2.35 billion lats and in comparative 1995 prices GDP was 2.41 billion lats.
Per capita GDP was 1,111 lats in 1996 versus 934 lats in 1995, the committee added.
It said the 1996 rise was helped by a leap in output of the transport and communications sector, which includes the important oil transit business, by 13.5 percent to 395.74 million lats.
